input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Clause 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and an exclusive foreign venue, i.e. walk-away territory. It also conflicts with 28.2, which already grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York. The minimal cure is to change only the law words in 28.1 to the laws of the State of New York and delete the conflicting Singapore forum, leaving the New York County forum in 28.2 (and the 28.3 escalation process) untouched; the result is a permitted corresponding pair at the preferred level.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law in 28.1 from Singapore to the laws of the State of New York and deleted the conflicting Singapore forum, leaving the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County already agreed in 28.2 to govern.
proposal.summary: Change 28.1 to New York law and delete the conflicting Singapore forum.
